submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F1 with the minimum allowed plate thickness (2 mm). The recorded activation study shows Absorber-F1 has the lowest residual dose at 1 m after one week of cooldown (6 uSv/h), comfortably below the 20 uSv/h hard limit; Absorber-F2 also passes at 12 uSv/h, while Absorber-F3 fails at 85 uSv/h. No documented 100 GeV energy-resolution simulation results were recorded for any candidate configuration, so compliance with the hard 4.5% resolution requirement cannot be confirmed from the available results. Among dose-compliant options, choosing the thinnest allowed absorber plates is the most defensible choice for pursuing the best sampling energy resolution, but this recommendation should be treated as conditional pending the missing resolution simulation/validation.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: No resolution results were recorded: num_resolution_results_found = 0 and num_candidate_configs_with_resolution_recorded = 0. A 2 mm plate is selected because it is the minimum allowed thickness and is generally favorable for sampling resolution, but the actual 100 GeV resolution is not documented.
